desc.zh-Hans: 增加了新开通的7号线、5号线；依照站台上张贴的线路图，加入了近期将要开通的1号线南延（红嘴子至永春南）、3号线南延（长影世纪城至文远大路）、9号线（雾开河大街至九台南站），更改了一个车站的名称（职业学院→职业技术大学）
desc.en: Added the newly opened Line 7 and Line 5. Based on the route maps posted on station platforms, included the soon-to-open southern extension of Line 1 (Hongzuizi to Yongchun Nan), southern extension of Line 3 (Changying Shijicheng to Wenyuan Dajie), and Line 9 (Wukaihe Dajie to Jiutainan Zhan). Renamed one station (Zhiye Xueyuan→ Zhiye Jishu Daxue).

updateHistory.reason: 新增长春图（修复 #39 提到的问题）
Update English translation and add new stations
Update all station English names to lowercase Pinyin and add Line 6
Route Map in all stations of Changchun Rail Transit was updated on September 28, 2025.

Changchun Rail Transit Line 7 opened on August 26, 2026, and Changchun Rail Transit Line 5 opened on September 28, 2026. The revision is made based on the official website of Changchun Rail Transit and the new network map posted on station platforms, with information on lines scheduled to open in the near future added.
